dumpSql.jobs: SELECT model,status,error FROM wiki_compile_jobs ORDER BY created_at,rowid
dumpSql.items: SELECT title,fingerprint,published FROM wiki_compile_items ORDER BY rowid
dumpSql.blocks: SELECT item_id,block_key,block_json,status,contributions_json,error,attempts FROM wiki_compile_blocks ORDER BY rowid
dumpSql.cache: SELECT item_id,block_hash,model,contributions_json FROM wiki_block_cache ORDER BY item_id,block_hash,model
dumpSql.contributions: SELECT item_id,block_key,page_title,contribution_json FROM wiki_contributions ORDER BY item_id,block_key,page_title
dumpSql.ingestions: SELECT item_id,content_hash,model,prompt_version,failure_count,CASE WHEN next_attempt_at IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN next_attempt_at > CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 THEN 'future' ELSE 'past' END AS next FROM wiki_ingestions ORDER BY item_id
dumpSql.pages: SELECT normalized_title,title,kind,summary,body,aliases_json,provider,model,prompt_version,manual_edited_at IS NOT NULL AS manual FROM wiki_pages ORDER BY normalized_title
dumpSql.sources: SELECT p.normalized_title AS page,s.item_id FROM wiki_page_sources s JOIN wiki_pages p ON p.id=s.page_id ORDER BY p.normalized_title,s.item_id
dumpSql.links: SELECT f.normalized_title AS a,t.normalized_title AS b FROM wiki_page_links l JOIN wiki_pages f ON f.id=l.from_page_id JOIN wiki_pages t ON t.id=l.to_page_id ORDER BY a,b
dumpSql.revisions: SELECT p.normalized_title AS page,r.title,r.summary,r.body,r.model FROM wiki_page_revisions r JOIN wiki_pages p ON p.id=r.page_id ORDER BY p.normalized_title,r.rowid
dumpSql.suggestions: SELECT p.normalized_title AS page,s.draft_json,s.reason FROM wiki_page_suggestions s JOIN wiki_pages p ON p.id=s.page_id ORDER BY p.normalized_title
dumpSql.fts: SELECT title,summary,body FROM wiki_fts ORDER BY title,body
dumpSql.invalidated: SELECT page_title FROM wiki_invalidated_pages ORDER BY page_title
